points.description: States that the peak discharge (peak outflow) is reduced/attenuated by the reservoir routing (outflow peak lower than inflow peak).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated, e.g. 'flood is reduced' or 'flow is reduced' without reference to the peak.

points.description: States that the peak flow is shifted/delayed in time (peak outflow occurs later than peak inflow; lag or time shift of the peak).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated, e.g. 'time changes' or 'flow is delayed' without reference to the peak.

rubric.notes: Two aspects, 1 mark each: peak discharge reduced (attenuation) and peak shifted/delayed in time. Accept synonyms such as attenuated, lowered, lag, delayed. Give part marks for vague statements that miss the word 'peak'; give no marks for unrelated aspects such as storage capacity or spillway design alone.
